name: com.gameframex.unity.objectstorage.aliyun
displayName: Game Frame X Object Storage ALiYun OSS
description:
ALiYun OSS provider for GameFrameX ObjectStorage. Implements ALiYunObjectStorageManager for Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service, allowing you to upload and download files and directories to and from ALiYun OSS buckets in both runtime and editor through the ObjectStorage contracts, with the ALiYun OSS SDK shipped under Plugins. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX ObjectStorage 的阿里云 OSS 实现功能包。基于 ObjectStorage 契约实现阿里云对象存储服务的 ALiYunObjectStorageManager，运行时与编辑器均支持上传、下载文件和目录到/从阿里云 OSS 存储桶，阿里云 OSS SDK 位于 Plugins 目录。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
